info.name: Benchmark Email RESTful API v3.0 ABTest Creation Segments API

description.content:
RESTful API for managing email marketing contacts, lists, campaigns, automations, reports, images, and webhooks within the Benchmark Email platform. To use the API, you need a Benchmark Email API token available at https://ui.benchmarkemail.com/Integrate#API. Rate limit: 500 calls per 2 minutes and 60,000 calls per day.

Contact Support:
 Name: Benchmark Email Developer Support
